name: Vancouver (ICMJE Recommendations + NLM Sample References / Citing Medicine 2nd ed.) — citations and reference list
publisher: ICMJE / U.S. National Library of Medicine
status: verified-vancouver-icmje-nlm: Citing Medicine Chapter 1 (NBK7282) and Chapter 2 (NBK7271) read from the browser print-PDFs. Grouped citations, list numbering, and page layout remain journal options.

sources.nlm_samples: https://www.nlm.nih.gov/bsd/uniform_requirements.html (Samples of Formatted References for Authors of Journal Articles, last reviewed June 2, 2026; copy: vanc_src/nlm_sample_references.txt)
sources.citing_medicine: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK7282/ (Citing Medicine 2nd ed., Chapter 1 Journals) and https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK7271/ (Chapter 2 Books). Browser print-PDFs: research/vanc_src/citing_medicine/NBK7282-chapter-1-journals.pdf and NBK7271-chapter-2-books.pdf. Read 2026-10-11.
sources.pubmed: https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi (PubMed records: MEDLINE journal abbreviation, volume, issue, pages, authors; results in vanc_src/pubmed_verification.json)

grades.R: rule text read in ICMJE, on NLM's Sample References page, or in Citing Medicine chapters 1-2
grades.U: journal option: record the choice, never guess a rule

layout.policy: untouched: ICMJE gives no page-layout rules (font, spacing, margins, title page) and says to follow the target journal's instructions

citations.order: numbered consecutively in order of first mention (ICMJE)
citations.multiple: (1, 4): separator and range style are not specified by ICMJE -> flagged
citations.placement: left where the author typed the citation (not specified) -> no change

authors.format: Surname + initials without periods or spaces (Halpern SD)
authors.grade: R (Sample References #1 text: 'List the first six authors, followed by et al.')

title.case: sentence case; lowercase after a colon; acronyms and proper nouns kept
title.grade: R (Citing Medicine Ch 1, Article Title, General Rules)

journal.abbrev: MEDLINE abbreviation (ICMJE: 'abbreviated according to the style used for MEDLINE'); taken from the PubMed record (source field), never guessed
journal.punct: no periods inside the abbreviation; '. ' after it

date.format: year[ Mon[ day]]; three-letter month without a period (2002 Jul 25)
date.grade: R (Citing Medicine Ch 1, Date of Publication, General Rules)

volume_issue_pages.pages: 123-125 becomes 123-5; do not shorten 124A-126A; keep a leading letter (S10-8); keep roman numerals
volume_issue_pages.grade: R (Citing Medicine Ch 1, Location (Pagination), General Rules)

doi.grade: R (Sample References, optional MEDLINE format, 'Article with a Digital Object Identifier')

book.format: Authors. Title. Edition. Place: Publisher; year.
book.grade: R (Citing Medicine Ch 2A Entire Books; NLM sample #19)

list_numbering.format: 1. 2. 3. as plain text numbers with hanging indent
list_numbering.grade: U (journal option: neither ICMJE nor the Sample References page shows how the list itself is numbered)
